summary: Completed comprehensive testing of show_goal_amount visibility control feature for 4Luis platform. All 9 backend API tests passed (100%). Frontend UI verified - Admin checkbox and badges working correctly. Fixed missing show_goal_amount field in JourneyUpdate model.
passed_tests: Backend: Main journey hides goal_amount when show_goal_amount=false (only % visible)
Backend: PUT /api/admin/journeys/{id}/show-goal returns 404 for invalid journey
Backend: GET /api/homepage/ambassador-journeys respects show_goal_amount per journey
Backend: Admin GET /api/admin/journeys includes show_goal_amount field
Backend: General update PUT /api/admin/journeys/{id} can change show_goal_amount
Backend: New journeys default to show_goal_amount=false
Frontend: Homepage main-journey shows only percentage when show_goal_amount=false
Frontend: Homepage main-journey shows €X / €Y when show_goal_amount=true
Frontend: Admin journeys list shows badge '% Apenas' for show_goal_amount=false
Frontend: Admin journeys list shows badge '€ Público' for show_goal_amount=true
Frontend: Admin edit mode shows checkbox 'Mostrar objetivo €'
Frontend: Admin checkbox toggle persists and updates homepage display
critical_code_review_comments: FIXED: Added show_goal_amount to JourneyUpdate model (was missing, preventing Admin UI checkbox from working)
All show_goal_amount features are now fully functional
Some older journeys (Japão, Vietname, Paris, Londres, Nova Iorque) don't have show_goal_amount field set in DB - they default to false correctly
General update endpoint PUT /api/admin/journeys/{id} now supports show_goal_amount
updated_files: /app/backend/server.py (added show_goal_amount to JourneyUpdate model at line 199)
context_for_next_testing_agent: show_goal_amount visibility control fully tested and working. Fix applied: added show_goal_amount to JourneyUpdate model. Main journey 'China' has show_goal_amount=false (default). Test journey 'Aventura em Bali' has show_goal_amount=true. Admin credentials: admin@4luis.com / admin_password

feature_1_default_false.description: Campo show_goal_amount na viagem - default false
feature_1_default_false.details: New journeys created via admin have show_goal_amount=false by default

feature_2_homepage_percentage_only.description: Homepage main-journey mostra apenas percentagem quando show_goal_amount=false

feature_4_ambassador_journeys.details: Each ambassador journey's show_goal_amount controls whether goal_amount is included in response

feature_5_admin_checkbox.description: Admin pode editar show_goal_amount via checkbox 'Mostrar objetivo €'
feature_5_admin_checkbox.details: Checkbox visible in edit mode, toggles correctly, persists on save

feature_6_dedicated_endpoint.details: Returns success message, updates database, validates parameters

feature_7_admin_badges.description: Lista de viagens no Admin mostra badge '% Apenas' ou '€ Público'
feature_7_admin_badges.details: Green badge '€ Público' when true, gray badge '% Apenas' when false
